name: inbound-from-demonstrated-build
goal: vague agency / category pitch → inbound request for a specific already-shown build
observed_workflow: Refuse outbound “I can automate your business” / cold “AI consulting” (VIEW A)
Have or make one specific artifact (not a category)
Post that artifact (thread / video). Publish HITL
Wait for inbound “could you do THAT for me?”
IF you must enter a room: free work only in exchange for documented proof you can post (HITL)
agent_abilities: draft a proof post of a named hive machine (do not publish)
state: SKU unknown until inbound names the class of job they saw
guardrails: send / pay / deploy / book / publish stay HITL
do not unpark clients or start a hunt
VIEW A and VIEW B stay separate — VIEW B not installed from this clip
do not average with outbound-first tapes
reproduce: Dry-run only: pick one already-stolen machine and draft a proof post. Do not publish. Caption-honest; no invented clicks.
generalize: Same primitive: specific artifact → public proof → inbound for that class. Notes only. Do not wire.
improve: HITL spine already have (ask-principal, send-removed). Do not “improve” by auto-publish or free-work without Evens.
